quote: Freedom is not doing whatever you want. It is having the quiet strength to say no to yourself, so the world never has to.
reflection: When we fail to govern our own appetites, external consequences eventually govern them for us. Real independence begins the moment you master your own restraint.
question: What is one impulse you had to tame to truly feel in control?
